sentences.en: I was nervous at first, but gradually got more relaxed.
sentences.zh: 起初我很紧张，但渐渐地放松下来。

sentences.en: It gradually dawned on me that I had misunderstood him.
sentences.zh: 我逐渐意识到我对他的理解有误。

sentences.en: As the sun rises, the morning mist gradually fades away.
sentences.zh: 随着太阳升起，晨雾渐渐消散。
